docs.title: What is Digital Logbook?
docs.text:
Digital Logbook is a centralized web platform that streamlines the full project lifecycle — from inviting users and assigning projects to tracking daily work logs and generating progress reports. Every role has a dedicated workspace tailored to their responsibilities.

⚡

Fast onboarding Invite users and activate accounts in minutes

🔐

Role-based access Clear permission boundaries for every user type

📈

Progress visibility Track team momentum with structured daily logs

docs.title: About Digital Logbook
docs.text: Digital Logbook is a role-based project tracking platform built for training programs, mentorship workflows, and academic industry projects.

docs.title: Mission
docs.text:
Our mission is to make project supervision simple, transparent, and measurable for everyone involved:

  • Super Admins manage users and program operations
  • Mentors guide learners with actionable feedback
  • Students document progress through structured activity logs

docs.title: Why Teams Use Digital Logbook
docs.text:
🧭

Clear ownership Every role has a focused workspace and responsibilities

🧱

Structured reporting Standardized logs make progress review consistent

🧠

Better mentoring Feedback loops help students improve faster

📦

Audit-ready history All entries are centralized for reporting and review

docs.text:
• Clarity: dashboards and records should be easy to understand
  • Consistency: workflows should be repeatable across projects
  • Accountability: every update should reflect real progress
  • Growth: feedback should drive better outcomes over time

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: This guide will help you activate your account and log in to the Digital Logbook platform for the first time.

docs.title: First Time Account Setup
docs.text:
Before You Begin

You must receive an invitation email from a Super Admin before you can register. Contact your Super Admin if you have not received one.

docs.title: Step 1: Check Your Email
docs.text:
You will receive an invitation email from the Digital Logbook system. Open your inbox and look for the invitation message.

Cannot find the email?

  • Check your Spam or Junk folder
  • Ask the Super Admin to resend the invitation

docs.title: Step 2: Open the Invitation Link
docs.text:
Click the invitation link inside the email. This link opens the registration page and activates your account setup process.

Link Expiry

Invitation links expire after a set period. If your link is no longer working, contact the Super Admin and request a new invitation.

docs.title: Step 3: Complete Your Registration
docs.text:
Fill in your details on the registration form:

  • Full Name
  • Email Address (pre-filled)
  • Password — choose a strong, memorable password

Click Submit to complete your registration.

docs.title: Step 4: Login to the System
docs.text:
Once registered, you can log in:

  1. Open the login page
  2. Enter your email address
  3. Enter your password
  4. Click Login

You will be redirected to your dashboard.

docs.title: Login Screen Preview
docs.text: Web ViewMobile View

docs.title: Daily Login Process
docs.text:
For returning users, follow these steps every time you log in:

  1. Open the login page
  2. Enter your email address
  3. Enter your password
  4. Click Login
  5. Wait for your dashboard to load

After logging in, use the left sidebar menu to navigate the system.

docs.title: Understanding the Dashboard
docs.text:
The dashboard is your main overview page. Depending on your role, it may show:

Element Description Assigned Projects Projects you are linked to Recent Activities Latest activity log entries Progress Summary Overall project progress status Notifications System alerts and updates

docs.title: Sidebar Menu
docs.text:
The left sidebar provides access to all system modules:

  • Dashboard — Main overview
  • Users — Manage or view users (Super Admin only)
  • Projects — View and manage projects
  • Activity Logs — Log and review daily activities
  • Reports — Generate and export reports
  • Feedback — View and write feedback

Available menu items depend on your assigned role.

docs.title: Search and Filters
docs.text:
Most listing pages include a search bar and filter options to help you quickly find:

  • Projects
  • Students
  • Activity logs
  • Reports

docs.title: Pagination
docs.text:
When a page contains many records, they are split into multiple pages. Use the pagination controls at the bottom of the page to navigate between pages.

  • Super Admins → Super Admin Guide
  • Mentors → Mentor Guide
  • Students → Student Guide

docs.title: Glossary
docs.text: Key terms used across the Digital Logbook platform.

docs.title: Core Terms
docs.text: Activity Log A daily or periodic update submitted by a student describing tasks, results, blockers, and next actions. Invitation A secure email link used to activate a user account. Pending Invitation An invitation that has been sent but not accepted. Expired Invitation An invitation link that is no longer valid and must be reissued. Project Assignment Linking mentors and students to a specific project. Feedback Entry A mentor or admin comment attached to an activity log to guide improvement. Blocker A problem preventing progress (for example, dependency delay, missing access, or unresolved issue). Role-Based Access Permission model where each user sees only the modules/actions allowed by role. Report Export Downloading filtered project/activity data as PDF for review or sharing.

docs.title: Role Terms
docs.text: Super Admin Platform manager with full control over users, projects, invitations, and reports. Mentor Reviewer and guide responsible for evaluating student updates and providing feedback. Student Contributor who logs daily progress and acts on mentor suggestions.

docs.title: Mentor Guide
docs.text: As a Mentor, your role is to guide and support students throughout their projects. This guide covers how to view students, review their work, and provide meaningful feedback.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Capability Description View Students See all students assigned to your projects Review Activities Read submitted activity logs Provide Feedback Write comments and suggestions on student entries Monitor Progress Track student consistency and overall progress

docs.title: Interface Preview
docs.text:
Typical screen areas for Mentor users:

  • Student and activity overview section
  • Activity detail panel for context
  • Feedback panel for actionable comments

docs.title: Viewing Your Assigned Students
docs.text:
1. Log in to the system
  2. Open the Students section from the sidebar
  3. Review the list of students assigned to your projects

Tip

Use the search bar or filters if you have a large number of students assigned.

docs.title: Reviewing Student Activities
docs.text: Student activity logs show what work was completed, what challenges were faced, and what is planned next.

docs.title: Steps to Review an Activity
docs.text:
1. Open a student's profile or go to the Activity Logs section
  2. Select a specific activity entry to view the full details
  3. Review the following fields:
    • Tasks completed
    • Results achieved
    • Blockers or challenges
    • Planned next steps

Consistency Matters

Check whether the student is submitting logs regularly. Inconsistent updates may signal that a student needs additional support.

Web ViewMobile View

docs.title: Providing Feedback
docs.text: Feedback helps students improve their work and stay on track.

docs.title: Steps to Leave Feedback
docs.text:
1. Open a student's activity entry
  2. Scroll to the Feedback section
  3. Write your comments in the feedback field
  4. Click Save to submit your feedback

The student will be notified and can view your comments on their next login.

Web ViewMobile View

docs.title: Writing Effective Feedback
docs.text:
Good feedback should be:

Quality Description Clear Easy to understand with no ambiguity Constructive Focused on improvement, not just criticism Specific Reference specific tasks or issues Actionable Give the student something concrete to act on Encouraging Acknowledge good work alongside areas for improvement

docs.title: Example of Good Feedback
docs.text: "Your task breakdown is detailed and well structured. For next week, try to include the specific outcomes or results for each task rather than just listing what was done. This will help show the impact of your work more clearly."

docs.title: Example of Poor Feedback
docs.text: "Good job. Keep it up."

docs.title: Monitoring Student Progress
docs.text:
Regularly reviewing student progress helps you identify students who may be struggling early.

Signs a student may need extra support:

  • Missing or infrequent activity log updates
  • Consistently reporting the same blockers
  • Vague or incomplete entries
  • No improvement after previous feedback

Be Proactive

Reach out to students who appear to be falling behind rather than waiting for them to ask for help.

docs.title: Best Practices for Mentors
docs.text:
• Review student activity logs at least once a week
  • Respond to activity entries with timely, actionable feedback
  • Acknowledge progress and improvements, not just problems
  • Support students who are struggling with additional guidance
  • Log out after working on shared or public devices

docs.text:

  • Reviews activity logs and leaves actionable feedback

docs.title: Change Requests
docs.text:
Need permission changes?

  1. Contact Super Admin
  2. Describe module and required action
  3. Include business reason for the access update

Warning

Do not share one account across multiple users. Permissions are role-based and tied to individual accountability.

docs.title: Security and Privacy
docs.text: Digital Logbook uses role-based access and operational safeguards to protect user data and project records.

docs.title: Security Principles
docs.text:
• Least privilege access by role
  • Individual account accountability
  • Controlled invitation-based onboarding
  • Operational review through reports and logs

docs.title: All Users
docs.text:
• Use strong passwords
  • Do not reuse passwords across systems
  • Log out on shared devices
  • Do not share login credentials

docs.title: Super Admins
docs.text:
• Remove or disable unused accounts
  • Review invitation status and expiration regularly
  • Verify role assignments frequently

docs.title: Data Handling Guidelines
docs.text:
• Activity logs should contain project-relevant information only
  • Avoid storing personal sensitive data in free-text fields
  • Exported reports should be shared only with authorized stakeholders

docs.title: Incident Response
docs.text:
If you suspect unauthorized access:

  1. Notify Super Admin immediately
  2. Reset affected passwords
  3. Review recent activity and account assignments
  4. Document the incident and actions taken

docs.title: Privacy Note
docs.text:
Each organization is responsible for local policy compliance regarding retention, processing, and sharing of project and user information.

For support, visit Contact & Support.

docs.title: Student Guide
docs.text: As a Student, Digital Logbook is your workspace for recording daily activities, tracking project progress, and receiving feedback from your mentor.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Capability Description Dashboard View assigned projects and recent activity summaries Activity Logs Record your daily tasks and progress Mentor Feedback Read comments and suggestions from your mentor Project Progress Track your overall project status

docs.title: Interface Preview
docs.text:
Typical screen areas for Student users:

  • Dashboard summary with assigned projects
  • Activity form for daily log submissions
  • Feedback and notification area for mentor guidance

docs.title: Your Dashboard
docs.text:
After logging in, your dashboard gives you a quick overview of everything important.

The dashboard displays:

Section Description Assigned Projects Projects you are currently enrolled in Recent Activity Logs Your latest submitted entries Progress Updates Summary of your overall project progress Mentor Feedback Notifications Alerts when your mentor has left new feedback

docs.title: Creating Activity Logs
docs.text: Activity logs are the core of Digital Logbook. You should update your log every day or after completing significant work.

docs.title: Adding a New Activity Log
docs.text:
1. Open the Activity or Logbook section from the sidebar
  2. Click Add Activity
  3. Fill in the activity form with the following details:
Field What to Include Tasks Completed List what you worked on and finished Results Achieved Describe the outcome or output of your work Challenges or Blockers Note any problems or obstacles you faced Next Planned Actions State what you plan to work on next
  1. Click Save to submit your entry
Web ViewMobile View

Write Clearly

The more detail you include, the better feedback your mentor can give you. Avoid vague entries like "worked on project" — be specific about what you actually did.

docs.title: Example Activity Log Entry
docs.text:
Tasks Completed: Completed the database schema design for the user authentication module. Created entity relationship diagrams.

Results Achieved: Schema reviewed and approved by team lead. Ready for implementation phase.

Challenges or Blockers: Uncertain about the best approach for storing session tokens securely. Need to research options.

Next Planned Actions: Research session token storage methods. Begin implementation of the login API endpoint.

docs.title: Viewing Mentor Feedback
docs.text: Your mentor may leave feedback and suggestions on your activity entries.

docs.title: How to View Feedback
docs.text:
1. Open the Activity Logs section
  2. Select the activity entry that has a feedback notification
  3. Read your mentor's comments in the Feedback section
Web ViewMobile View

Act on Feedback

Feedback is provided to help you improve. Review it carefully and apply the suggestions in your next activity entries.

docs.title: Responding to Feedback
docs.text:
Although you may not reply directly to feedback in all cases, you can demonstrate that you have acted on it by:

  • Referencing the feedback in your next activity log entry
  • Showing improvement in the areas your mentor highlighted
  • Updating your planned actions based on mentor suggestions

docs.title: Tracking Your Progress
docs.text:
Your project progress is updated based on your activity log submissions and mentor reviews.

To stay on track:

  • Submit activity logs consistently and on time
  • Keep your entries accurate and detailed
  • Address blockers proactively — don't let the same blocker appear week after week
  • Review your overall progress from the dashboard regularly

docs.title: Monthly Attendance
docs.text:
Use the monthly attendance calendar to review and update your daily entries.

Web ViewMobile View

docs.title: Profile and Activity Timeline
docs.text:
Use your profile page to review activity history, streaks, and latest tasks.

Web View

docs.title: Best Practices for Students
docs.text:
• Update your activity logs daily or at the end of each work session
  • Be specific about what you worked on, what you achieved, and what blocked you
  • Read all mentor feedback carefully before submitting your next log
  • Reach out through the system if you need clarification or support
  • Log out after using shared or public devices

Need Help?

If you cannot see your project or your logs are not saving, visit the Troubleshooting & FAQ page or contact your Super Admin.

docs.title: Super Admin Guide
docs.text: As a Super Admin, you have full control over the Digital Logbook platform. This guide covers all major responsibilities and tasks.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: Capability Description User Management Invite, view, and manage all users Project Management Create and configure projects Mentor Assignment Assign mentors to projects Student Assignment Assign students to projects Reports Generate and export activity reports

docs.title: Interface Preview
docs.text:
Typical screen areas for Super Admin users:

  • Left navigation for users, projects, and reports
  • Top summary cards for quick status visibility
  • Main table area for invitations, assignments, and actions

docs.title: User Management
docs.text: The User Management section allows you to control who can access the system and what role they have.

docs.title: Sending a Single Invitation
docs.text:
1. Open the Users or Invitations page
  2. Click Invite User
  3. Enter the user's details:
    • Full name
    • Email address
  4. Select the appropriate role (Super Admin / Mentor / Student)
  5. Click Send Invitation

The user will receive an email with a registration link.

docs.title: Bulk User Invitation
docs.text:
Use bulk invitations to add multiple users at once via a spreadsheet file.

  1. Open the Bulk Upload section
  2. Download the spreadsheet template (if provided)
  3. Fill in user details (name, email, role) for each row
  4. Upload the completed file
  5. Review the validation results

Validation Errors

If any rows contain errors (e.g. invalid email, missing role), correct those rows and re-upload the file. Valid rows will not be affected.

docs.title: Invitation Status Reference
docs.text:
Status Meaning Pending Invitation sent — user has not registered yet Accepted User successfully completed registration Expired Invitation link has expired — resend required

Managing Expired Invitations

Periodically review invitation statuses and resend expired invitations to ensure all users can access the system.

docs.title: Creating a New Project
docs.text:
1. Open the Projects page
  2. Click Create Project
  3. Fill in project details:
    • Project name
    • Description
    • Start and end dates
  4. Click Save

docs.title: Assigning a Mentor to a Project
docs.text:
1. Open the project from the Projects page
  2. Navigate to the Mentor Assignment section
  3. Select the mentor from the list
  4. Click Save Changes
Web ViewMobile View

docs.title: Assigning Students to a Project
docs.text:
1. Open the project from the Projects page
  2. Navigate to the Student Assignment section
  3. Search for and select students to add
  4. Click Save Changes
Web ViewMobile View

Note

Assignments can be updated or removed at any time. Removing a student or mentor from a project does not delete their account.

docs.title: Generating a Report
docs.text:
1. Open the Reports page
  2. Apply filters as needed:
    • Date range — limit results by time period
    • Project — filter by specific project
    • Status — filter by activity or progress status
  3. Click Generate Report
  4. Review the results displayed on screen

docs.title: Exporting a Report
docs.text:
Once a report is generated:

  1. Click Export or Download PDF
  2. The report will be saved to your device as a PDF file

PDF reports are useful for sharing with stakeholders or keeping records offline.

docs.title: Onboarding Approval
docs.text:
Review and approve incoming mentor and mentee applications before assigning them to projects.

  1. Navigate to the Onboarding page from the sidebar
  2. Switch between the Mentor and Mentee tabs to review applicants
  3. Check applicant details and approve or reject as needed
  4. Approved users can then be assigned to projects

docs.title: Best Practices for Super Admins
docs.text:
• Monitor invitation statuses regularly and resend expired ones
  • Review project assignments to keep them accurate and current
  • Periodically audit user roles to ensure correct access levels
  • Export reports regularly for record keeping
  • Log out after working on shared devices

docs.title: Troubleshooting & FAQ
docs.text: This page covers the most common issues users encounter in Digital Logbook and how to resolve them.

docs.title: I Did Not Receive the Invitation Email
docs.text:
Steps to resolve:

  1. Check your Spam or Junk folder
  2. Confirm your email address with the Super Admin
  3. Ask the Super Admin to resend the invitation

Note

Invitation emails are sent from the system automatically. If your email provider is blocking them, ask the Super Admin to check the sending domain.

docs.title: My Invitation Link Is Not Working
docs.text:
Invitation links expire after a set period.

Steps to resolve:

  1. Contact the Super Admin and explain that your link has expired
  2. Ask for a new invitation to be sent
  3. Open the new email and use the new link immediately

Warning

Do not share your invitation link with others. It is unique to your account registration.

docs.title: I Forgot My Password
docs.text:
Steps to resolve:

  1. Open the login page
  2. Click Forgot Password (if available)
  3. Enter your email address
  4. Check your email for a password reset link
  5. Follow the instructions to set a new password

If no reset option is available, contact the Super Admin for assistance.

docs.title: I Cannot Log In Even With the Correct Password
docs.text:
Possible causes and solutions:

Cause Solution Account not yet activated Complete registration via the invitation link Account has been deactivated Contact the Super Admin Browser cache issue Clear your browser cache and try again Caps Lock is on Check that Caps Lock is off when typing your password

docs.title: I Cannot See Expected Pages or Menus
docs.text:
Some pages are only accessible to specific roles.

Possible reasons:

  • Your role does not have permission to access that module
  • You have not been assigned to a project yet

Steps to resolve:

  1. Confirm your role with the Super Admin
  2. Ask the Super Admin to assign you to the relevant project
  3. Log out and log back in to refresh your permissions

docs.title: A Page Is Not Loading or Showing an Error
docs.text:
Steps to resolve:

  1. Refresh the page using Ctrl + R (Windows) or Cmd + R (Mac)
  2. Clear your browser cache and cookies
  3. Try a different browser
  4. Check your internet connection

If the issue persists, contact the Super Admin with a description of the error.

docs.title: I Cannot Find My Data
docs.text:
Steps to resolve:

  • Check if any filters are active and clear them
  • Clear the search field and search again
  • Check the pagination — your data may be on another page
  • Refresh the page

docs.title: My Activity Log Did Not Save
docs.text:
Steps to resolve:

  1. Check your internet connection
  2. Do not navigate away before clicking Save
  3. Try submitting again
  4. If the issue continues, copy your content to a text file temporarily and contact the Super Admin

docs.title: I Cannot See My Mentor's Feedback
docs.text:
Possible reasons:

  • Your mentor has not yet submitted feedback on that entry
  • The feedback notification may not have refreshed

Steps to resolve:

  1. Refresh the page
  2. Open the specific activity log entry directly
  3. If feedback is still not visible, check with your mentor whether it was submitted

docs.title: A Bulk Upload Is Showing Errors
docs.text:
Steps to resolve:

  1. Download the error report or review the validation results
  2. Identify the rows with errors (e.g. invalid email format, missing role)
  3. Correct those specific rows in the spreadsheet
  4. Re-upload the corrected file

Tip

Rows without errors are processed successfully even if other rows fail. You only need to re-upload the rows that had issues.

docs.title: An Invitation Is Stuck in Pending Status
docs.text:
The user has not yet completed registration.

Steps to resolve:

  1. Confirm that the user received the invitation email
  2. Ask them to check their Spam folder
  3. If needed, resend or cancel the invitation and send a new one

docs.title: General FAQs
docs.text:
Q: Can I change my email address? Contact the Super Admin to update your account email address.

Q: Can I use Digital Logbook on a mobile device? Yes. The system is accessible from any device with a modern web browser.

Q: How often should students update their activity logs? Students should aim to update their logs daily or at the end of each work session.

Q: Can a student be assigned to more than one project? Yes. Super Admins can assign students to multiple projects if needed.

Q: What happens if I accidentally delete an entry? Contact the Super Admin immediately. Recovery options depend on system configuration.

Still Need Help?

If none of the above solutions resolve your issue, contact your Super Admin with:

  • A description of the problem
  • The steps you took before the issue occurred
  • Any error messages you saw

docs.title: Welcome to Digital Logbook
docs.text:
Welcome to Digital Logbook. This platform is designed to help Super Admins, Mentors, and Students manage projects, track daily activities, monitor progress, and communicate efficiently in one centralized system.

This guide will help new users understand how to access the platform, navigate the system, and use all major features confidently.

docs.title: First Time Account Setup
docs.text: If you are using Digital Logbook for the first time, follow these steps to activate your account.

docs.title: Step 1: Check Your Email
docs.text:
You will receive an invitation email from the Digital Logbook system. Open your email inbox and look for the invitation message.

If you cannot find the email:

  • Check your Spam or Junk folder
  • Contact the Super Admin and request a new invitation email

docs.title: Step 2: Open the Invitation Link
docs.text: Click the invitation link provided in the email. This link is used to activate your account and complete your registration.

docs.title: Step 3: Complete Your Registration
docs.text: Fill in the required information and create your password. Make sure your password is secure and easy for you to remember. After completing the form, click the Submit button.

docs.title: Step 4: Login to the System
docs.text:
Once registration is complete:

  1. Open the login page
  2. Enter your email address
  3. Enter your password
  4. Click Login

You will now be redirected to your dashboard.

docs.title: Daily Login Process
docs.text:
If your account is already activated, follow these steps each time you log in.

  1. Open the login page
  2. Enter your email address
  3. Enter your password
  4. Click Login
  5. Wait for your dashboard to load

After logging in, use the left sidebar menu to navigate through the system.

docs.title: Understanding User Roles
docs.text: Digital Logbook provides different access levels based on user roles.

docs.title: Super Admin
docs.text:
The Super Admin manages the entire platform and controls system operations.

Main responsibilities include:

  • Managing users
  • Sending invitations
  • Creating projects
  • Assigning mentors and students
  • Monitoring reports and project activities

docs.title: Mentor
docs.text:
Mentors are responsible for guiding and monitoring students.

Main responsibilities include:

  • Reviewing student activities
  • Monitoring student progress
  • Providing feedback and guidance

docs.title: Student
docs.text:
Students use the platform to record their daily work and track project progress.

Main responsibilities include:

  • Creating activity logs
  • Updating project progress
  • Reviewing mentor feedback
  • Improving work based on feedback

docs.title: Dashboard
docs.text:
The dashboard provides an overview of important information related to your role. Depending on your role, the dashboard may display:

  • Assigned projects
  • Recent activities
  • Progress summaries
  • Notifications and updates

docs.title: Sidebar Navigation
docs.text:
The left sidebar menu is used to access system modules and pages. Available menu items may include:

  • Dashboard
  • Users
  • Projects
  • Reports
  • Activity Logs
  • Feedback Sections

The available options depend on your assigned role.

docs.title: Search and Filters
docs.text:
Some pages contain search bars and filter options. These tools help users quickly find:

  • Projects
  • Students
  • Reports
  • Activities
  • Users

docs.title: Pagination
docs.text: If a page contains many records, the system may divide the information into multiple pages. Use the pagination controls at the bottom of the page to move between pages.

docs.title: User Management
docs.text: The User Management section allows Super Admins to control user access within the system.

docs.title: Sending Invitations
docs.text: Super Admins can invite users individually or in bulk.

docs.title: Single User Invitation
docs.text:
Steps:

  1. Open the Users or Invitations page
  2. Click Invite User
  3. Enter user information
  4. Select the correct role
  5. Send the invitation

docs.title: Bulk User Invitation
docs.text:
Bulk invitations allow multiple users to be added at once.

Steps:

  1. Open the bulk upload section
  2. Upload the required spreadsheet file
  3. Verify user details
  4. Submit the upload
  5. Review validation results

If errors appear, correct the invalid rows and upload the file again.

docs.title: Invitation Status Types
docs.text: Each invitation will display a status.

docs.title: Pending
docs.text: The invitation has been sent but the user has not accepted it yet.

docs.title: Accepted
docs.text: The user successfully completed registration.

docs.title: Expired
docs.text: The invitation link is no longer valid. If the link has expired, send a new invitation.

docs.title: Project Management
docs.text: Super Admins can create and manage projects within the system.

docs.title: Creating a Project
docs.text:
Steps:

  1. Open the Projects page
  2. Click Create Project
  3. Enter project details
  4. Save the project

docs.title: Assigning Mentors to Projects
docs.text:
Steps:

  1. Open the selected project
  2. Choose mentor assignment
  3. Select the mentor
  4. Save changes

docs.title: Assigning Students to Projects
docs.text:
Steps:

  1. Open the selected project
  2. Choose student assignment
  3. Add students
  4. Save changes

Assignments can be updated or removed later if necessary.

docs.title: Reports and Exports
docs.text: The Reports section helps generate reports for monitoring and analysis.

docs.title: Generating Reports
docs.text:
Steps:

  1. Open the Reports page
  2. Select filters such as:
  3. Date range
  4. Project
  5. Status
  6. Click generate report
  7. Review the generated results

docs.title: Exporting Reports
docs.text: Reports can be downloaded as PDF documents for sharing or record keeping.

docs.title: Viewing Assigned Students
docs.text:
Mentors can access students assigned to their projects.

Steps:

  1. Login to the system
  2. Open the Students section
  3. Review the assigned student list

Use filters if the student list is large.

docs.title: Reviewing Student Activities
docs.text:
Mentors can monitor student work and progress.

Steps:

  1. Open a student profile or activity page
  2. Review submitted activity logs
  3. Monitor consistency and progress

docs.title: Providing Feedback
docs.text:
Mentors can leave feedback on student activities.

Steps:

  1. Open a student activity entry
  2. Write feedback comments
  3. Save the feedback

Good feedback should be:

  • Clear
  • Constructive
  • Helpful
  • Action oriented

Mentors should review student progress regularly.

docs.title: Viewing the Dashboard
docs.text:
Students can use the dashboard to view assigned projects and activity summaries. The dashboard may include:

  • Project details
  • Recent activity logs
  • Progress updates
  • Mentor feedback notifications

docs.title: Creating Activity Logs
docs.text: Students should update their activity logs regularly.

docs.title: Adding a New Activity Log
docs.text:
Steps:

  1. Open the Activity or Logbook section
  2. Click Add Activity
  3. Enter activity information

Include:

  • Tasks completed
  • Results achieved
  • Challenges or blockers faced

  • Next planned actions

  • Save the activity entry

docs.title: Viewing Mentor Feedback
docs.text:
Mentors may leave comments and suggestions on activity logs. Students should:

  • Review feedback carefully
  • Improve future work using mentor suggestions
  • Maintain regular updates

docs.title: I Did Not Receive the Invitation Email
docs.text:
Try the following steps:

  • Check your Spam or Junk folder
  • Confirm your email address with the Super Admin
  • Request the invitation to be sent again

docs.title: Invitation Link Is Not Working
docs.text: Do not worry. The invitation link may have expired. Contact the Super Admin and request a new invitation link. Open the new email invitation and try again.

docs.title: I Cannot See Expected Pages or Menus
docs.text:
Possible reasons include:

  • Your role does not have permission to access the module
  • You are not assigned to a project yet

Contact the Super Admin for assistance.

docs.title: I Cannot Find My Data
docs.text:
Try the following steps:

  • Check active filters
  • Clear search fields
  • Review pagination pages
  • Refresh the page

docs.title: For All Users
docs.text:
• Review your dashboard regularly
  • Keep information accurate and updated
  • Save updates carefully
  • Logout after using shared devices

docs.title: For Super Admins
docs.text:
• Monitor invitation statuses regularly
  • Remove expired invitations when necessary
  • Review project assignments frequently

docs.title: For Mentors
docs.text:
• Review student activity consistently
  • Provide useful and actionable feedback
  • Support students who require additional guidance

docs.title: For Students
docs.text:
• Update activity logs daily
  • Clearly explain blockers and challenges
  • Read mentor feedback carefully
  • Stay consistent with project updates

docs.title: Final Note
docs.text: Digital Logbook is designed to improve collaboration, activity tracking, and project management for all users. Regular updates, clear communication, and consistent feedback help ensure successful project progress and better learning outcomes for everyone using the platform.

docs.title: Real Workflow Examples
docs.text: These examples show how the platform is used in real day-to-day scenarios.

docs.title: Goal
docs.text: Prepare a new project batch with mentors and students.

docs.title: Flow
docs.text:
1. Create project
  2. Send invitations to mentors and students
  3. Monitor invitation statuses
  4. Assign mentors to project
  5. Assign students to project
  6. Verify dashboard and reporting visibility

docs.title: Success Outcome
docs.text: All users are active and projects are ready for daily activity tracking.

docs.title: Goal
docs.text: Review student activity quality and unblock progress.

docs.title: Flow
docs.text:
1. Open assigned students list
  2. Filter by latest activity date
  3. Review each submitted activity log
  4. Add feedback comments with next action
  5. Flag repeated blockers for follow-up

docs.title: Success Outcome
docs.text: Students receive clear, prioritized feedback and maintain momentum.

docs.title: Goal
docs.text: Record meaningful daily progress and keep mentor informed.

docs.title: Flow
docs.text:
1. Open Activity or Logbook section
  2. Add tasks completed
  3. Add measurable results
  4. Note blockers and risks
  5. Define next planned actions
  6. Submit log and review mentor feedback later

docs.title: Success Outcome
docs.text: Progress history becomes clear, measurable, and easy to evaluate.

docs.title: Goal
docs.text: Prepare summary report for management review.

docs.title: Flow
docs.text:
1. Open Reports page
  2. Set filters (project, date range, status)
  3. Generate report
  4. Validate key metrics
  5. Export PDF
  6. Share with stakeholders

docs.title: Success Outcome
docs.text: Decision-makers receive reliable project progress snapshots.
